blurb: Discover Los Angeles through its chilling true crime history on this immersive sightseeing experience that explores the infamous O.J. Simpson and Menendez Brothers murder cases. Journey through West L.A. from the glamorous streets of Brentwood to Beverly Hills, retracing the real locations tied to these shocking 1990s tragedies. With Grave Line Tours, uncover the dark intersections between fame, family, and fatal obsession that forever changed Hollywood’s story.
